items.full_description: Video message from Dries Buytaert, Drupal Founder.

items.title: 基調講演：James Abrahams — AI Integration with Drupal (Keynote)
items.full_description: Keynote by James Abrahams, Co-Founder of FreelyGive. James maintains the AI module for Drupal and co-founded the Drupal AI Initiative, helping steer Drupal's artificial intelligence strategy. His work focuses on integrating AI services with Drupal to unlock new editorial and developer workflows.

items.title: 全体写真撮影 (Group Photo)
items.full_description: Group photo with all DrupalCamp Tokyo 2026 attendees.

items.title: AI時代にDrupalは不要になるのか？ — DrupalはCMSではなく知識基盤になる (Is Drupal Unnecessary in the AI Era? Redefining Drupal as Knowledge Infrastructure)
items.full_description:
生成AIの普及により、コンテンツは瞬時に作れる時代になりました。その結果、「ページを作る」という従来のCMSの役割は価値を失いつつあります。

This session redefines Drupal's role through structured content, open web principles, and digital experience platforms, positioning it as a trusted knowledge foundation rather than a content generator.

items.title: 非エンジニアがPHPゼロで作ったDrupalサイト (Non-Engineer Built Drupal Site Without PHP Knowledge)
items.full_description: A non-engineer with minimal HTML and CSS experience built a character-appreciation Drupal site by leveraging AI assistance and developer support while maintaining creative ownership throughout. This session demonstrates accessible pathways into Drupal adoption and shows how the platform can empower creators who are not programmers.

items.title: 機能紹介で終わらせない — 刺さるDrupalデモの組み立て方 (Beyond Feature Lists: Crafting Compelling Drupal Demonstrations)
items.full_description:
聴衆が知りたいのは機能の存在ではなく、「それが自分の課題をどう解決するか」です。

Transforms demo strategy from a "feature catalog" approach to a problem-solution narrative. Covers storytelling techniques and audience-adapted approaches applicable across community events and professional settings.

items.title: ランチブレイク (Lunch Break)
items.full_description: Lunch break.

items.title: Ironstar v5のご紹介 — 日本市場向けに特別に構築された新しいエンタープライズ向けホスティングプラットフォーム (Introducing Ironstar v5: Enterprise Hosting Platform Built for Japan)
items.full_description: Presents the latest enhancements to Ironstar's managed Kubernetes environment, including dynamic environments, sub-minute deployments, database encryption, advanced WAF controls, and Tokyo regional infrastructure optimised for enterprise compliance requirements in the Japanese market.

items.title: コードは書くな、フローを語れ！プロンプト指向プログラミングで始める業務オーケストレーション (Speak Flows, Not Code: Prompt-Oriented Programming for Business Orchestration)
items.full_description:
コードを書き続ける限り、業務フローの変更は「実装変更」から逃れられません。

Introduces prompt-oriented programming, shifting workflow logic from code to AI-driven prompts. YAML-based executable specifications enable dynamic validation, transformation, multilingual support, and access controls — reducing static implementation changes when business rules evolve.

items.title: HTMX in Drupal 入門 (Introduction to HTMX in Drupal)
items.full_description: Explains the adoption of the HTMX lightweight library in Drupal 11.3+, where it offers an alternative to Form State and Ajax APIs for dynamic interactions. Includes hands-on exploration of rendering approaches and integration methods, making it accessible to developers transitioning from traditional Drupal AJAX patterns.

items.title: FOSSは転機を迎えているか？ — Drupal・WordPress・QGISコミュニティリーダーによるパネルディスカッション (Has Open Source Software Reached an Inflection Point? Panel Discussion)
items.full_description: Community leaders from Drupal, WordPress, and QGIS explore how free and open source software is positioned in 2026. Panellists discuss leadership approaches across different platforms, sustainability challenges, and future directions shaping open-source strategy — including the impact of AI tooling on community contribution models.

items.title: Drupalエコシステムの拡張と、自律型AI「Acquia AI」が切り拓く次世代プラットフォーム (Drupal Ecosystem Integration and Autonomous AI: Next-Generation Platform Vision)
items.full_description: The first half covers Drupal ecosystem solutions including DAM, web governance, A/B testing, and personalisation. The second half reveals Acquia's 2026 roadmap, featuring a centralised digital experience management system powered by autonomous AI that can orchestrate content, targeting, and delivery with minimal manual intervention.

items.title: Drupalでパラレル開発がした〜い (Parallel Development in Drupal: Current Workflow Innovation)
items.full_description: Demonstrates a DDEV and Git worktree methodology (originally presented at Florida DrupalCamp 2026) that enables simultaneous multi-environment development. Shows how AI agent integration and workflow automation can further accelerate the developer experience when working across parallel feature branches.

items.title: Claude CodeでつくるDrupal Themingエージェント ── 40本のViewsを自動化した試行錯誤の記録 (Building Drupal Theming Agents with Claude Code: Automating 40+ Views Through Trial and Iteration)
items.full_description: Chronicles the development of an AI-powered theming agent that automated more than 40 Views in a large-scale Drupal project. Shares the full debugging process — correcting template errors, refining prompt design, and achieving stable automation through iterative improvement — giving a realistic picture of AI-assisted Drupal development in production.

items.title: ブレイクタイム (Break)
items.full_description: Break.

items.title: Drupal × Fastly：AI時代のトラフィック激増に備える、高速化とエッジセキュリティの最適解 (Drupal × Fastly: Edge Security and Performance for AI-Driven Traffic Surges)
items.full_description: Addresses the AI-era challenge of dramatically increased traffic from learning crawlers and bot scraping. Showcases Fastly's edge cloud capabilities including sub-150ms cache purging, device-optimised image delivery, ContentGuard AI bot blocking, and API Discovery for shadow-API protection — all applied to Drupal deployments.

items.title: TBD (Trans Cosmos Inc.) — セッション情報は後日公開予定
items.full_description: Session details to be announced. Presented by Trans Cosmos Inc.

items.title: My First Drupal Contribution in Nara (And How You Can Make Yours!)
items.full_description: Demystifies the Drupal contribution process using Cloud IDEs and simplytest.me for browser-based coding, testing, and merge requests. Encourages both developers and non-coders to engage with the Drupal community by walking through the first-contribution experience from DrupalCon Asia 2025 in Nara.

items.title: AI と走ることについて語るとき僕の語ること (Reflections on Running Alongside AI: Judgment and Adaptation)
items.full_description:
「AI 疲れる」と言っててもこの変化から逃げられる訳もなく。

Examines accelerating work processes with AI and the career implications for developers. Argues that sharpening judgment and decisiveness is the competitive advantage as AI commoditises technical execution.

items.title: Webセキュリティの注意事項とDrupalをKUSANAGIで超高速化 (Web Security Essentials and Drupal Ultra-Fast Performance with KUSANAGI)
items.full_description:
AIによるサイバー攻撃では、脆弱性が見つかってから4時間後で攻撃が始まるデータがあります。

Covers rapid defence strategies, a practical web security checklist for Drupal site owners, and the KUSANAGI optimisation methodology for achieving ultra-fast Drupal performance.

items.title: TBD (amazee.io Japan) — セッション情報は後日公開予定
items.full_description: Session details to be announced. Presented by amazee.io Japan.

items.title: Drupal SDC入門 (Introduction to Single Directory Components)
items.full_description: Explores Single Directory Components (SDC) fundamentals alongside Drupal Canvas component-based page building. Covers implementation strategy, operational considerations, and practical pitfalls for both beginners and advanced practitioners looking to modernise their Drupal frontend architecture.

items.title: D4からD11まで！ Drupalを編集部がいじって増築して20年走り続けているメディアの裏側 (Drupal 4 Through 11: 20 Years of Editorial-Driven Platform Evolution)
items.full_description:
2006年の開始時からずっと、Drupalで運営しています。

Documents two decades of Drupal operation spanning Drupal 4.x through Drupal 11, managing over 70,000 nodes across four unified media properties using 80 custom modules. Covers the editorial team's direct involvement in shaping the platform and the rationale for consolidating multiple properties onto a single installation.

items.title: コクヨ株式会社様：120周年「ワンコクヨ」を旗印に、全ての事業領域サイトを統合リニューアル (Kokuyo 120th Anniversary: "One Kokuyo" Unified Business Platform Integration)
items.full_description: A case study presenting how Kokuyo unified five business domains — stationery, furniture, space solutions, e-commerce, and corporate — under a single Drupal platform as part of the company's 120th anniversary initiative. Presented jointly by the Kokuyo team (Adachi, Okuyama) and the SCSK implementation team (Tanaka, Kowada) who delivered the "One Kokuyo" digital transformation.

items.title: Webサイト攻撃状況レポートサービス＆高PV安定化-インフラレッドのソリューション (Website Attack Intelligence and High-Performance Stability Solutions)
items.full_description: Presents InfraRed's website security reporting service, which delivers actionable intelligence on attack patterns, and their high-traffic stability infrastructure solutions. Covers practical approaches to keeping Drupal sites performant and secure under sustained high page-view loads.

items.title: DistributionからSite Templateへ 〜 Kamihaya CMS開発から考えるDrupal再利用アーキテクチャ 〜 (Distribution to Site Template: Drupal Reuse Architecture Evolution via Kamihaya CMS)
items.full_description:
Features、Install Profile、Distribution、Configuration Management、Composer、そしてRecipe。

Traces the evolution of Drupal's reuse mechanisms through to Site Templates. Uses the Kamihaya CMS as a concrete case study to examine the limitations of Distributions, the advantages of the Site Template approach, and where Drupal's reuse architecture is heading.

items.title: Dance with Waterfall and Agile
items.full_description:
クライアントのウォーターフォール型思考と開発者のアジャイル型思考との対立。

Drawing on over 10 years of bridging both methodologies, the speaker shares practical strategies for making Waterfall-oriented clients and Agile development culture work together toward shared project success.
